typedef struct session_server_like_config session_server_like_config_t

typedef asciichat_error_t(*) session_server_like_init_fn(void *user_data)

Shared server-mode orchestration. Networking is owned by network_server_t; modes supply one callback set for TCP, WebSocket, and authenticated peers. Listeners are constructed before init_fn and started only after it succeeds. All connections drain before cleanup_fn releases mode dependencies. The interrupt callback only publishes atomic shutdown requests.
